messages:
Maria: Heads-up — finalizing next week's newsletter + launch email for the Benchmark webinar. Need segmentation, send windows, and a quick embed/tone check. Draft plan pasted below. Please flag any blockers by EOD Thu.

Raj: Quick question — do we route trial signups to the webinar invite first or the demo flow? My vote: invite first, then demo 48h after no click.

Maria: I prefer invite-first as well. Routing rules proposal:
- trial -> webinar_invite if created < 7d
- active_users -> product_update

Example snippet:
```
if user.source == 'trial' and created_at > now()-7d:
  route='webinar_invite'
else:
  route='nurture'
```
Thoughts?

Sam: Works for me. One ask: can we limit webinar_invite to users with opens > 1 in last 14d? That'll help reduce bounces and improve CVR.

Toni: +1 to Sam. Also flag on send windows — APAC prefers localized send or a different UTC window. 0200-0700 UTC hits business hours in EU but is rough for APAC. Suggest using timezone send or moving APAC recipients to 0200-0600 UTC equivalent. Ops can implement timezone splitting but need final list.

Elaine: Tone check — current newsletter copy is pretty technical. For the public newsletter I'd like two short sections: "What's new" (3 bullets) and "Why it matters" (1 sentence). I'll draft language and attach a trimmed version for the launch email.

launch-bot: Reminder: campaign 'benchmark-webinar-03' scheduled send placeholder at 1762950000. Status: draft. :bell:

Maria: Thanks — @Sam @Toni please confirm send window (US/EMEA/APAC) + throttle (we usually do 5k/hr for initial blast). I'll update the segmentation doc here (draft): https://docs.redwood.com/campaigns/benchmark-newsletter.

Raj: :thumbsup: I'll push updated routing rules and share a quick validation query for ops to run tomorrow morning.
